description: This file defines the main App component for a React frontend application. It manages theme toggling, hash-based routing, and tabbed navigation between 'AvailabilityManager' and 'ScheduleICU' components, and handles navigation to a separate ScheduleManager view.

methods.name: useHashRoute
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages hash-based routing, providing current route state and navigation function.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function to toggle between 'ocean' and 'dark' themes.

methods.name: renderMainContent
methods.description: Function that conditionally renders the main content area based on current route, either showing ScheduleManager or tabbed views.
